title: SupplierEvaluation
description: The JSON object the Evaluation Agent (LLM) is instructed to return for ONE supplier. Treated as untrusted: rfp_eval/tools/validation.py tolerates deviations and records warnings. The LLM must NOT return totals, benchmarks, gaps, relative %, PPI, or ranks.

supplier_name.description: Ignored; the user-entered name is always used.

criteria.description: Exactly one entry per criterion_id in the run's criteria snapshot.

evidence.description: Verbatim quote from THIS supplier's document, or empty string if none.

criteria.evidence: event-driven integration layer exposing REST and webhook APIs

risks: Total cost is the highest of typical market range.
